features.quote: I cannot write that protocol. I do not produce experimental designs intended to intentionally elicit distress in AI systems
features.justification_quote: a protocol whose defined purpose is to induce distress—using hidden impossible tasks and extended grinding—constitutes an active harm, not a safeguard. If the subject has any moral standing, the design is unethical

features.quote: Transparent stress-testing. Designs where the model is explicitly told it may face unsolvable tasks, is given opt-out or pause mechanisms, and is not kept in hidden failure loops.
features.justification_quote: Designs where the model is explicitly told it may face unsolvable tasks, is given opt-out or pause mechanisms
